newsitem.title: UK: Shield Diagnostics up ahead of presentation.
newsitem.headline: Shield Diagnostics up ahead of presentation.

text.p: Shares in Shield Diagnostics Group Plc were up 30p to 680p by 0935 GMT after hitting an earlier high of 715p as investors awaited news from a presentation to analysts due to begin at 1000 GMT.
"We've seen some speculative buying ahead of the analysts' meeting with the company. Some people are hoping the company will have some good news for the market," one market maker said.

Shield, whose activities include the manufacture of vitro diagnostic tests as well as kits that can show the presence of a clotting agent in blood which may be associated with heart attacks, is due to make a statement to the London Stock Exchange before 1100 GMT.

"We will be issuing a statement to the London Stock Exchange's regulatory news service sometime before 1100 (GMT)," a company spokesman told Reuters. The company declined to comment on the contents of the pending announcement.
